title: The glitch needs to be fixed
body:
The app is really good for it’s simplicity & minimalism but one of the bugs that I have came across lately is when you make a repeated task for years, it simply doesn't works. It’s a glitch Google needs to fix. Try creating a task for today and next same task for next year and it simply wont happen. Though the app feature says it should happen, so please fix this.

Also, I have multiple lists and I have to personally go to every list to check the tasks for "Today". You can simply make a common folder where all the important tasks in different lists comes together in "Today". That’s one of the most basic things in a task or To-do app.

Rest, the app is great. Thank You.
